mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user WHERE active = #{active}

SELECT d.department_code, d.department_name, COUNT(u.user_id) AS user_count FROM department d LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.department_id = d.department_id AND u.active = 1 GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_code, d.department_name ORDER BY d.department_id
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM production_plan GROUP BY status
SELECT i.item_name, pp.production_qty, pp.status, pp.due_date FROM production_plan pp JOIN item i ON i.item_id = pp.item_id ORDER BY pp.created_at DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM material_request GROUP BY status
SELECT i.item_name, sm.movement_type, sm.quantity, sm.created_at FROM stock_movement sm JOIN item i ON i.item_id = sm.item_id ORDER BY sm.created_at DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM procurement GROUP BY status
SELECT i.item_name, p.request_qty, p.status, p.required_date FROM procurement p JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vendor_quote WHERE status = 'REQUESTED'
SELECT p.board_id, p.post_id, b.board_name, p.title, p.created_at FROM board_post p JOIN board b ON b.board_id = p.board_id WHERE p.active = 1 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 5
